attributes.originalText: The transcript runs the full height of the pane, so the last answer keeps scrolling until it reaches the bottom edge of the screen. The composer floats over it and the fade carries the text into the page colour instead of cutting it off at a hard line.

attributes.originalText: This is the final answer of the transcript, and it decides whether the bottom edge reads as a continuation of the conversation or as a strip of empty page colour: it must be able to scroll above the floating composer, and everything below the composer must still look like the surface the answer is drawn on. A reader who flings the list to the end should see the answer fade into the page rather than stop short of it.
